The intended universal upper bound is recoverable from the companion, but the manuscript should supply its quantifier.

findings.disposition: The present contract and manuscript agree on the literal mathematical target; preserve these conventions in later revisions.
findings.statement: The theorem excludes size 68 and therefore yields maximum size at most 67. Empty-core sunflowers, simplicity, exact uniformity and unrestricted ambient support are stated explicitly. The final upper bound 68 from the prior paper is not used as a premise.

findings.disposition: These are explicit assurance boundaries, not newly asserted unproved combinatorial hypotheses. Later rounds must inspect the named bridges and active finite predicates rather than infer correctness from PASS labels.
findings.statement: The manuscript discloses that H27 is imported without a local full-ledger replay, Jin's exact statement was inspected through Nikiforov, and exact LP replay shares model construction. Its partial Lean results are not represented as a formal proof of the extremal theorem.

required_revisions: Define the scalar neighbourhood notation N used in Sections 5 and 6, or replace each N<=c by the quantified statement |N[R]|<=c for every actual R. State explicitly that an N43 anchor is an actual member R with |N[R]|=43. Section 3 currently defines only the set N[R] and the minimum mu.
content.summary: The literal theorem, maximum-size convention, arbitrary-support scope and top-level maximum-degree decomposition are coherently framed. The distinction between imported computer-assisted theorems, new finite obligations and partial Lean assurance is explicit. I found no framing-level contradiction, but the scalar neighbourhood notation in Sections 5 and 6 requires definition. This round does not certify the finite leaves or all imported structural premises.
